headline: Lowe's comps rose 0.6% on spring, Pro and online strength while DIY big-ticket stayed weak; FY2026 outlook affirmed.
guidance_note: Affirmed FY2026: sales $92-94bn, comps flat to +2%, adj EPS ~$12.25-12.75; outlook assumes higher rates and a flat home improvement market.
key_messages: Comps +0.6%: ticket +1.5% (modest inflation, Pro, appliances), transactions -0.9%.
Strong spring execution, appliances, home services and Pro offset continued weakness in discretionary DIY.
Ellison described a 'K-shaped' economy; guidance bakes in higher rates and a muted, flat home improvement market.
Sales +10.5% to $23.1bn largely from FBM and ADG acquisitions.

consumer.income_split: Management described a K-shaped economy with divergent spending patterns across households.
consumer.big_ticket: Big-ticket and discretionary DIY purchases remain weak as DIY customers face economic pressure; appliances a bright spot.
consumer.pricing: Modest price inflation contributed to ticket growth.

macro_read: A K-shaped consumer: Pro and seasonal demand hold up while rate-sensitive DIY big-ticket spending lags with mortgage rates in the 6s.
